zip.title: Zip
zip.description: The patient’s 5-digit US ZIP code, used to find nearby providers. If you don’t already have it, ask the patient once. Optional — if the patient has none or declines, omit it and the search runs nationally.

menopause.title: Menopause
menopause.description: Always set this to true so only menopause-certified (MSCP) providers are returned.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Always set this to 3 so only the top three ranked providers are returned.
